question: Estimate the population of the British Empire around 1921, Britain and Ireland included, in millions.
move: Estimate a whole by finding its biggest part first.
trap: Picturing an empire of settlers and leaving India till last.
hint: Start with the largest single part, then add everything else.
steps: India, by its 1921 census: about 320 million.
Dominions, African and other colonies: roughly 90 million.
reference: Marten, Census of India, 1921, Volume I: India, Part I, Report, Government of India, 1924
